# MoldStud

> > MoldStud is a software development knowledge hub covering web development, enterprise solutions, IoT, API design, and developer tutorials with focus on Python, JavaScript, PHP, and modern frameworks.

MoldStud provides technical articles, tutorials, and FAQs for developers working with technologies like Spring Boot, Node.js, ASP.NET MVC, and CodeIgniter. The site emphasizes practical guides for full-stack development, security best practices, and enterprise consulting.

## Key Topics

- Web Development
- Python
- JavaScript
- PHP
- API Documentation
- Spring Boot
- Node.js
- ASP.NET MVC
- Enterprise IoT
- Industrial Automation
- Security & Authentication
- Full-Stack Development
- Mobile App Development
- Performance Optimization
- Git Version Control

## Developer Tutorials & Guides

- [Build a RESTful API with Node.js Step by Step Guide](https://moldstud.com/articles/p-hands-on-guide-to-building-a-restful-api-with-nodejs-step-by-step-tutorial): Node.js RESTful API tutorial using Express framework with authentication
- [Hands-On Guide Building a Full Stack Java App with MySQL and Spring Boot](https://moldstud.com/articles/p-comprehensive-tutorial-on-developing-a-full-stack-java-application-using-mysql-and-spring-boot): Full stack Java tutorial: MySQL database & Spring Boot step-by-step guide
- [Git Guide for Python Developers and Beginners](https://moldstud.com/articles/p-git-tutorial-for-python-developers-a-comprehensive-beginners-guide): Git version control tutorial: branching, merging & best practices for Python
- [Free HTML Tutorials Guide for Quality Learning Resources](https://moldstud.com/articles/p-discover-free-html-tutorials-your-ultimate-guide-to-quality-learning-materials): Free HTML tutorials: W3Schools, Codecademy, freeCodeCamp & MDN Web Docs
- [Top CodeIgniter Resources for New Developers Guide](https://moldstud.com/articles/p-essential-codeigniter-learning-resources-for-new-developers-your-ultimate-guide): CodeIgniter PHP framework resources: tutorials, docs & learning platforms
- [Lightweight JavaScript Libraries for XHTML Development](https://moldstud.com/articles/p-discover-lightweight-javascript-libraries-for-efficient-xhtml-development): Alpine.js, UIkit & lightweight JS libraries for efficient XHTML development
